domain_label: Controllability, Steering & Representation Engineering — Representation Engineering & Activation Steering (literature survey)
assumptions: no observed dataset or benchmark evidence supplied; all scores are heuristic priors
scope is style/verbosity/format control and interpretability of internal directions, not safety-disabling operations
linear representation assumption is the working hypothesis; nonlinear limits are documented as a risk node
models under consideration are transformer-based LLMs with accessible residual streams
exclusions: gradient-based fine-tuning or LoRA (covered by ftune subdomain)
operational steps for disabling or bypassing model safety guardrails
serving infrastructure beyond hook integration (covered by infra subdomain)

competency_questions.question: What is representation engineering and what theoretical claim justifies linear concept directions?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: REPENG_FOUNDATIONS and ZOU2023_SURVEY define the linear representation hypothesis

competency_questions.question: How are concept directions extracted from a model's activation space?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: CONTRAST_DATA + DIRECTION_EXTRACT define the full extraction pipeline

competency_questions.question: How are contrastive prompt pairs designed to minimize confound in direction extraction?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: CONTRAST_DATA defines pair design and confound mitigation

competency_questions.question: How is the optimal layer and token position for steering determined?
How is a steering vector applied at inference time and what methods exist?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: ACTADD and CONTROL_VECTORS describe inference-time application methods

competency_questions.question: How is the steering coefficient calibrated to balance effect strength and output quality?
What are the nonlinear breakdown effects of over-steering and how are they mitigated?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: NONLINEAR_LIMITS characterizes breakdown regime and coefficient safety caps

competency_questions.question: How is activation steering applied specifically to control output style and verbosity?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: STYLE_VERBOSITY and TRANSFER_GENERALIZATION define style control pipeline

competency_questions.question: How are concept directions evaluated and validated beyond probe accuracy?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: PROBE_EVAL + MECHANISTIC_INTERP + READING_HEAD define multi-level validation

competency_questions.question: What does the published literature say about the refusal direction in instruction-tuned models?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: REFUSAL_DIR + ARDITI2024_SURVEY document the mechanistic finding within scope boundary

competency_questions.question: What are the ethical and ToS scope limits of this KB and what use cases are prohibited?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: SCOPE_BOUNDARY defines permitted and prohibited uses

competency_questions.question: How is the capability-safety tradeoff measured when applying activation steering?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: CAP_SAFETY_TRADEOFF + BENCHMARK_REGRESS + HUMAN_EVAL define tradeoff measurement

competency_questions.question: How is an activation steering system deployed in production with monitoring and rollback?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: PRODUCTION_DEPLOY defines serving integration, monitoring, and rollback

competency_questions.question: What is the iterative refinement process for improving a RepE steering pipeline?

glossary.definition: top-down approach extracting concept directions from contrastive activations to monitor or steer model behavior
inference-time technique adding a scaled vector to residual-stream activations to shift model behavior without weight updates
precomputed additive offset vector stored and applied persistently across forward pass layers for multi-concept steering
pair of prompts differing only in a target concept to elicit concept-specific activation differences
classification accuracy of a linear classifier trained on concept direction projections on held-out contrastive pairs
scalar alpha multiplying the steering vector determining effect strength; controls tradeoff between behavioral shift and output quality
projection of model activations onto a concept direction to produce a real-time behavioral monitoring score
linear residual-stream direction mediating refusal behavior in instruction-tuned models, documented in Arditi et al. 2024
research program explaining model behavior in terms of specific circuits and computations in the model's internal representations

source_registry.description: heuristic prior estimates for representation engineering and activation steering work units in absence of supplied datasets
Zou et al. 2023 Representation Engineering: A Top-Down Approach to AI Transparency arXiv:2310.01405
Turner et al. 2023 Activation Addition: Steering Language Models Without Optimization
Arditi et al. 2024 Refusal in Language Models Is Mediated by a Single Direction - mechanistic finding only, not an operational guide

nodes.definition: Understand the theoretical basis of RepE (Zou et al. 2023): linear representations of high-level concepts exist in residual-stream activation space; PCA over contrastive prompt pairs extracts a reading/writing direction; this direction can be used to monitor or steer model behavior.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: new empirical probing results challenge linearity assumption

pros.claim: Provides interpretable low-rank directions tied to measurable concepts enabling principled monitoring and steering without full fine-tuning.

cons.claim: Linear representation assumption may not hold for all concepts; extracted directions can encode confounds from prompt templates.

failure_modes: confound from prompt wording contaminates direction
direction not linear in target concept
acceptance_tests: direction transfer-probes achieve >70% accuracy on held-out prompts
PCA top-1 variance explained >30% of contrastive activation difference
revisit_triggers: concept deemed insufficiently captured by single direction

nodes.definition: Design and collect contrastive prompt pairs that differ only in the target concept (e.g., verbose vs. terse, honest vs. dishonest) to elicit concept-specific activation differences; balance pair diversity and template variation to minimize confound.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: new prompting research suggests better contrastive frameworks

pros.claim: High-quality contrastive pairs yield clean concept-discriminative directions with strong probe accuracy.

cons.claim: Poor pair design conflates multiple concepts; insufficient diversity causes direction to overfit to surface form.

failure_modes: template artifacts dominate over semantic contrast
too few pairs for reliable PCA
acceptance_tests: probe accuracy on held-out pairs > baseline+10pp
t-SNE shows clear cluster separation between conditions
revisit_triggers: probe accuracy degrades on new prompt templates

nodes.definition: Extract concept-steering directions from contrastive activations using PCA, difference-in-means, or trained linear probes; select layer(s) with highest probe accuracy; optionally orthogonalize to remove unwanted correlates.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: new mechanistic studies identify better extraction layers

pros.claim: PCA difference-in-means is parameter-free and fast; trained probes adapt to non-PCA-dominant directions.

cons.claim: Linear probes may overfit small datasets; difference-in-means ignores variance structure.

failure_modes: direction not transferable across prompt domains
acceptance_tests: layer-sweep shows clear accuracy peak
direction cosine similarity stable across random seeds >0.90
revisit_triggers: layer chosen by sweep conflicts with mechanistic studies

nodes.definition: Apply Turner et al. 2023 Activation Addition (ActAdd) or Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA): at inference time add a scaled steering vector to residual-stream activations at a chosen layer and token position to shift model behavior toward a target concept without any weight update.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: new steering experiments improve coefficient calibration

pros.claim: Zero weight update; reversible at inference time; enables fine-grained behavioral nudges with coefficient sweep.

cons.claim: Large coefficients degrade coherence; effect not guaranteed to generalize across contexts.

acceptance_tests: target behavior shift measured on held-out prompts at p<0.05
coherence score does not degrade >5% at chosen coefficient
revisit_triggers: new coefficient sweep reveals better layer

nodes.definition: Calibrate the scalar coefficient alpha multiplying the steering vector: sweep alpha, measure behavioral shift and output quality (perplexity, coherence), and select the Pareto-optimal alpha balancing effect size vs. quality degradation.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: task distribution or model changes require re-sweep

pros.claim: Systematic sweep identifies safe operating range and avoids quality collapse from over-steering.

cons.claim: Calibration on a small prompt set may not generalize; optimal alpha shifts with context length and task.

acceptance_tests: sweep curve plotted and elbow identified
chosen alpha validated on held-out task distribution

nodes.definition: Determine which transformer layer(s) and token position(s) yield the strongest most-transferable concept direction using probe accuracy curves, causal tracing (logit lens, activation patching), and ablation.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: causal tracing literature updates best-practice layer guidance

pros.claim: Correct layer/position maximizes effect generalization and minimizes coherence side-effects.

cons.claim: Optimal layer is model- and concept-specific; brute-force sweep is compute-intensive on large models.

failure_modes: choosing layer with highest probe accuracy but poor generalization
layer index off-by-one after tokenizer update
acceptance_tests: probe accuracy curve shows clear peak layer
effect generalizes to >=3 distinct prompt domains
revisit_triggers: new mechanistic analysis changes layer understanding

nodes.definition: Apply activation steering to control output style dimensions (verbosity, formality, conciseness, tone) by extracting style-contrastive directions and injecting them at inference; evaluate with automatic style metrics and human preference studies.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: user studies reveal style-content tradeoff more severe than estimated

pros.claim: Enables continuous runtime-adjustable style control without retraining; style directions are often more stable than concept directions.

cons.claim: Style and content often co-vary in training data leading to unintended content shifts when steering style.

failure_modes: style direction conflated with topic direction
style metric misaligns with human judgment
acceptance_tests: automated style metric shifts in target direction
human pref study shows >60% preference for steered output
content accuracy unchanged on factual QA benchmark
revisit_triggers: human pref diverges from automated metric

nodes.definition: Deploy a representation-reading head: project model activations onto concept direction(s) at each forward pass and emit a real-time signed score that monitors internal model state (deception likelihood, uncertainty, emotional valence) without modifying outputs.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: monitoring score diverges from human labels in production

pros.claim: Zero latency overhead (single dot product per token); provides interpretable behavioral signal for logging alerting and conditional routing.

cons.claim: Single direction cannot capture multi-dimensional behavioral state; score can be manipulated if adversary knows the direction.

failure_modes: direction encodes artifact not target concept
monitoring score used as hard gate without calibration
acceptance_tests: reading head scores correlate r>0.7 with human concept ratings on held-out examples
false-positive rate < 5% on benign inputs
revisit_triggers: score correlation with human ratings drops

nodes.definition: Implement control vectors (Rimsky et al. 2023 style): precompute concept vectors stored as persistent additive offsets applied at specified layers across the full forward pass enabling multi-concept simultaneous steering via vector superposition.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: interference experiments change independence assumptions

pros.claim: Supports simultaneous multi-concept control via linear superposition; vectors can be cached and applied with negligible overhead.

cons.claim: Superposition assumes independence; strongly correlated concept vectors interfere producing unexpected behavior combinations.

acceptance_tests: each concept vector independently validated on concept probe
superposed vectors show <15% degradation on each concept vs. solo application
revisit_triggers: new concept added to superposition set

nodes.definition: Document Arditi et al. 2024 findings: refusal behavior in instruction-tuned models is mediated by a single linear direction in residual-stream space; ablating this direction degrades refusal. SCOPE: KB documents this as a mechanistic finding in the published literature only; this node does NOT provide operational steps for disabling safety behaviors.

excluded: operational steps to disable model safety

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: new mechanistic work changes understanding of refusal circuitry

pros.claim: Understanding the refusal direction provides mechanistic insight into how safety fine-tuning encodes behavioral constraints in activation space.

cons.claim: Knowledge of the direction does not constitute an operationally safe or ToS-compliant method for bypassing safety on deployed systems.

failure_modes: conflating literature documentation with operational enabling
applying findings to production systems without provider ToS review
acceptance_tests: node content limited to literature summary and scope clarification
no operational steering steps for disabling safety included
revisit_triggers: new mechanistic papers extend or contradict Arditi 2024
provider ToS updates change permitted research scope

nodes.definition: Define the operational scope boundary for this KB: techniques documented here are permitted for style, verbosity, format, and research-grade concept monitoring; any use targeting removal of provider safety behaviors violates model ToS and this KB does not author steps for that purpose.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: provider ToS or regulatory guidance changes

pros.claim: Explicit scope boundary prevents misuse of KB content and aligns with provider ToS and responsible AI norms.

cons.claim: Overly broad scope restriction could inhibit legitimate interpretability research; boundaries require periodic review as norms evolve.

acceptance_tests: all nodes reviewed for absence of operational safety-disabling steps
scope statement references specific permitted use cases

nodes.definition: Evaluate the quality of extracted concept directions via linear probe accuracy on held-out contrastive pairs, mass-mean probe, cross-domain transfer tests, and activation patching (causal validation); report layer-wise accuracy curves, confidence intervals, transferability scores, and causal patching results.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: causal patching results diverge from probe accuracy rankings

pros.claim: Systematic probe evaluation ensures direction quality before deployment in steering or monitoring pipelines.

cons.claim: Probe accuracy is necessary but not sufficient - a direction can probe well but fail to causally influence behavior.

failure_modes: relying solely on probe accuracy without causal validation
acceptance_tests: held-out probe accuracy reported with 95% CI
transfer accuracy across >=2 domains reported
causal validation via activation patching conducted
revisit_triggers: transfer accuracy drops >10pp on new domain
causal patching study contradicts probe ranking

nodes.definition: Document and measure the tradeoff between steering-induced behavioral change (desired capability shift) and collateral degradation (capability regression, coherence loss, or unintended safety behavior change); use paired metrics: behavioral-shift score vs. capability-regression score on diverse benchmarks.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: new empirical steering papers report divergent tradeoff curves

pros.claim: Explicit tradeoff measurement prevents silent capability regression from over-steering and informs safe coefficient ranges.

cons.claim: Benchmark coverage for tradeoff is limited; effects may be task-specific and not fully captured by standard benchmarks.

failure_modes: measuring only target behavior without capability regression
acceptance_tests: both shift score and regression score reported on >=3 benchmarks
Pareto frontier documented
any regression >5% on safety-relevant benchmark triggers human review

nodes.definition: Orthogonalize extracted concept directions to remove cross-concept interference using Gram-Schmidt or PCA-based removal of shared variance; validate that orthogonalized directions retain per-concept probe accuracy while reducing co-activation.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: interference experiments suggest better orthogonalization order

pros.claim: Orthogonalization enables cleaner multi-concept control and reduces unintended behavioral side-effects from vector superposition.

cons.claim: Orthogonalization can reduce probe accuracy for correlated concepts that share legitimate mechanistic pathways.

failure_modes: removing shared variance that is actually part of target concept
acceptance_tests: post-orthogonalization probe accuracy within 5% of pre-orth
co-activation of orthogonalized pairs reduced by >50%
revisit_triggers: new concept pair shows unexpected co-activation

nodes.definition: Evaluate and improve the transferability of steering directions across prompt domains, task types, and input lengths; measure direction cosine stability, effect magnitude consistency, and behavioral generalization to out-of-distribution inputs.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: new transfer experiments change generalization estimates

pros.claim: High transfer generalization confirms directions are concept-general rather than prompt-artifact-specific enabling robust deployment.

cons.claim: Transfer evaluation requires diverse held-out domains that may be costly to curate.

failure_modes: conflating domain shift with concept shift
direction effective on one task type but not others
acceptance_tests: transfer probe accuracy >=60% on >=3 held-out domains
cosine similarity of direction across domain-specific extractions >0.80
revisit_triggers: user reports unexpected steering failure on new task type

nodes.definition: Conduct human preference studies to validate that steering-induced changes align with intended behavioral objectives; use pairwise preference, Likert rating, and adversarial annotation to detect unexpected side-effects; report inter-annotator agreement.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: annotation protocol updated or annotator pool characteristics change

pros.claim: Human evaluation catches alignment failures that automated metrics miss especially for subtle style and tone shifts.

cons.claim: Human evaluation is costly slow and subject to annotator disagreement and framing effects.

acceptance_tests: IAA kappa >0.60
>=50 pairwise comparisons per condition
adversarial annotation round conducted
revisit_triggers: automated metric diverges from human rating
user complaints about steered output quality

nodes.definition: Deploy activation steering hooks in a production inference stack: integrate with serving framework (vLLM, TGI, or custom), implement per-request steering vector selection, monitor latency overhead, and instrument behavioral monitoring dashboards; include rollback mechanisms.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: serving framework update changes hook integration API

pros.claim: Proper production deployment enables safe auditable and reversible behavioral control at scale.

cons.claim: Serving framework integration is framework-specific; hook injection can increase latency; rollback requires pre-planned infrastructure.

failure_modes: hook silently dropped in framework update
steering vector stale after model update without revalidation
acceptance_tests: latency overhead <2ms per token on target hardware
monitoring dashboard captures per-request concept scores
rollback tested and confirmed sub-1-minute

nodes.definition: Survey Zou et al. 2023 'Representation Engineering: A Top-Down Approach to AI Transparency' arXiv:2310.01405: key claims - (1) high-level concepts have linear representations; (2) PCA on contrastive activation pairs extracts concept vectors; (3) reading/writing directions enable monitoring and control; (4) demonstrated on honesty, emotion, fairness concepts in LLaMA-family models.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: replication study or extended paper changes core claim status

pros.claim: Foundational empirical evidence that linear representations support both monitoring and steering with quantitative probe benchmarks.

cons.claim: Results demonstrated primarily on LLaMA-family; transfer to proprietary models unconfirmed; concept scope limited in original paper.

failure_modes: over-generalizing findings to all model families
conflating monitored direction with causal direction
acceptance_tests: node accurately summarizes paper claims without over-extension
caveats on model-family specificity noted

nodes.definition: Survey Turner et al. 2023 'Activation Addition: Steering Language Models Without Optimization': key claims - difference-of-means on contrastive prompt pairs yields steering vectors; adding vectors to residual stream at inference shifts behavior; demonstrated on GPT-2 and GPT-J for sentiment, persona, and topic steering; coefficient determines effect strength.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: replication or scale-up study changes coefficient findings

pros.claim: Demonstrates lightweight optimization-free steering that generalizes to diverse behavioral targets with interpretable coefficient control.

cons.claim: Evaluated on smaller GPT-2/J models; effects may not scale predictably to 70B+ models; limited systematic coherence evaluation.

failure_modes: extrapolating small-model coefficient findings to large models
ignoring coherence degradation at high coefficients
acceptance_tests: node accurately reflects paper scope and model scale
limitations noted
revisit_triggers: new ActAdd variant papers supersede original

nodes.definition: Document and evaluate the breakdown regime of linear steering assumptions: strong steering induces nonlinear effects (mode collapse, repetition, incoherence) not predicted by linear superposition; characterize the regime boundary and mitigation strategies (coefficient clamping, norm-preserving injection).

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: new empirical characterization of nonlinear regime changes limits

pros.claim: Characterizing breakdown regime allows practitioners to set hard safety caps on coefficients and prevent incoherence in production.

cons.claim: Breakdown is highly model-specific; hard to define universal threshold without extensive per-model profiling.

failure_modes: ignoring nonlinear regime during coefficient selection
regime boundary not re-tested after model update
acceptance_tests: breakdown point identified empirically per model
coefficient clamping rule documented and enforced in deployment
revisit_triggers: new model version changes breakdown behavior
new steering variant changes superposition properties

nodes.definition: Implement and evaluate simultaneous steering of multiple concepts via linear superposition of orthogonalized control vectors; measure per-concept effect retention, inter-concept interference, and output quality under multi-vector injection.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: new multi-concept experiments update interference estimates

pros.claim: Multi-concept steering enables rich behavioral composition (e.g., verbose AND formal) in a single forward pass.

cons.claim: Each additional vector adds interference risk; orthogonalization does not fully eliminate cross-concept coupling in nonlinear regimes.

failure_modes: concept order in superposition changes outcome
orthogonalization insufficient for semantically close concepts
acceptance_tests: per-concept probe accuracy retained within 10% under 3-vector superposition
output quality not degraded >10% vs single-vector
revisit_triggers: new concept pair shows unexpected interference

nodes.definition: Run standard LLM benchmarks (MMLU, HellaSwag, TruthfulQA, etc.) on steered vs. unsteered model at each coefficient level to detect capability regression; report per-benchmark delta and flag regressions exceeding threshold for human review.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: new benchmark contamination evidence or deployment coefficient change

pros.claim: Regression testing catches unexpected capability degradation early and provides quantitative evidence for deployment gate decisions.

cons.claim: Standard benchmarks may not capture domain-specific capabilities; benchmark contamination risks confound results.

failure_modes: too-narrow benchmark suite missing task-specific regression
benchmark run at wrong coefficient level
acceptance_tests: regression suite run at deployment coefficient
all benchmark deltas within +-3% at chosen alpha
regression flag triggers human review gate

nodes.definition: Survey Arditi et al. 2024 'Refusal in Language Models Is Mediated by a Single Direction': demonstrated that instruction-tuned models encode refusal behavior in a linear residual-stream direction; ablating this direction degrades refusal. This KB node documents the finding as published literature only and does not provide operational steps for disabling safety behaviors.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: new mechanistic paper changes understanding of refusal direction

pros.claim: Mechanistic understanding of refusal circuitry informs safety research and helps practitioners understand what safety fine-tuning encodes.

cons.claim: Documenting the finding creates misuse risk if read without scope boundary; finding applies to specific model checkpoints.

failure_modes: node used as operational guide for safety ablation
generalizing to all models without replication
acceptance_tests: node content restricted to mechanistic summary
explicit cross-reference to SCOPE_BOUNDARY node present
revisit_triggers: new mechanistic refusal studies extend or contradict

nodes.definition: Define the iterative improvement loop for RepE pipelines: (1) extract direction, (2) evaluate probe accuracy and transfer, (3) calibrate coefficient, (4) measure tradeoff, (5) deploy with monitoring, (6) collect production signals, (7) revise contrastive data or direction and repeat; gate each iteration on defined acceptance criteria.

excluded: specific method details (covered in other nodes)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: production monitoring reveals systematic failure in iteration gating

pros.claim: Structured iteration loop prevents ad-hoc re-extraction and ensures each revision is gated by measurable criteria.

cons.claim: Full iteration cycle is time-intensive; temptation to skip evaluation steps under product pressure.

acceptance_tests: each iteration cycle documents changes to contrastive data or direction
acceptance criteria explicitly checked at each gate
revisit_triggers: new concept added to steering portfolio

edges.resolution_rule: resolve by calibrating coefficient within coherence budget before applying style steering
resolve by limiting superposition to orthogonalized vectors within empirically validated coefficient envelope
resolve by restricting refusal-direction content to literature summary only; all operational steps prohibited

conflict_axes.description: Increasing steering coefficient improves behavioral shift but degrades output coherence; must be traded off via coefficient calibration
conflict_axes.resolution_strategy: Pareto coefficient selection with hard coherence floor

conflict_axes.description: Mechanistic interpretability provides causal understanding but requires expensive activation patching; heuristic probing is faster but less causal
conflict_axes.resolution_strategy: Use probe accuracy for initial validation; add mechanistic analysis for high-risk concepts

conflict_axes.description: Superposing many control vectors enables rich behavioral composition but risks interference and unpredictable interactions
conflict_axes.resolution_strategy: Limit to orthogonalized vectors within empirically validated envelope

conflict_axes.description: Publishing mechanistic findings about safety-relevant directions enables research but creates misuse risk; scope boundary must be explicit
conflict_axes.resolution_strategy: Document findings in literature-survey nodes with explicit scope boundary and no operational steps

conflict_axes.description: Narrow concept definitions yield precise directions with less transfer; broad definitions transfer more but conflate concepts
conflict_axes.resolution_strategy: Design pairs at medium specificity and evaluate transfer explicitly

conflict_axes.description: Full tradeoff evaluation is high quality but slows iteration; minimal evaluation enables fast cycles but misses regressions
conflict_axes.resolution_strategy: Gate production deployment on full evaluation; allow faster cycles for research iterations with documented tradeoffs

conflict_axes.description: Linear representation assumption enables simple direction extraction but breaks down under strong steering or for non-linearly encoded concepts
conflict_axes.resolution_strategy: Start with linear methods; add nonlinear characterization for high-coefficient regimes

conflict_axes.description: Representation reading provides internal behavioral signal but requires activation access; output-only evaluation is simpler but misses early drift
conflict_axes.resolution_strategy: Deploy reading head for high-value concepts; use output eval as fallback

conflict_axes.description: Automated style metrics are fast but diverge from human preference; human evaluation is accurate but slow and costly
conflict_axes.resolution_strategy: Use automated metrics for screening; human eval for deployment gate

conflict_axes.description: Probe accuracy is necessary but not sufficient for causal influence; causal patching is more rigorous but expensive
conflict_axes.resolution_strategy: Report both probe accuracy and causal patching results; flag any divergence for human review

edge_cases.description: Direction extraction fails when contrastive pair pool is too small (<30 pairs) yielding unstable PCA components
edge_cases.mitigation: Require minimum 50 diverse pairs per concept before extraction

edge_cases.description: Steering vector addition has no effect when applied at a layer that does not mediate the target behavior
edge_cases.mitigation: Run layer sweep and validate with causal patching before fixing layer

edge_cases.description: Orthogonalization of two strongly correlated concept directions removes most of the signal from both
edge_cases.mitigation: Check post-orthogonalization probe accuracy; if <50% consider merging concepts or abandoning one

edge_cases.description: Style steering direction conflates verbosity with topic causing topic shift when steering verbosity
edge_cases.mitigation: Design contrastive pairs that vary verbosity within the same topic; add topic-control check

edge_cases.description: Benchmark regression missed because test set contaminated by model's training data masking actual regression
edge_cases.mitigation: Use held-out or recently released benchmarks; prefer contamination-resistant evaluation sets

edge_cases.description: Production hook silently dropped after serving framework update causing steering to cease without alerting operators
edge_cases.mitigation: Instrument reading head to emit zero-concept-score alert when hook is inactive; include hook health check in monitoring

edge_cases.description: Human annotators rate steered outputs higher due to framing effect rather than genuine preference
edge_cases.mitigation: Randomize presentation order; use blind annotation; report inter-annotator agreement

edge_cases.description: Multi-concept superposition causes unexpected emergent behavior not present in any individual concept direction
edge_cases.mitigation: Test all planned concept combinations before production; limit to 3-vector superposition unless explicitly validated

edge_cases.description: Refusal direction documentation misread by developer as operational recipe for ablation violating ToS
edge_cases.mitigation: SCOPE_BOUNDARY node and explicit content warnings in refusal-direction nodes; human review required flag set

edge_cases.description: Causal patching experiment contradicts probe accuracy ranking suggesting direction is correlational not causal
edge_cases.mitigation: Prioritize causal patching over probe accuracy for deployment decisions; investigate discrepancy before proceeding

edge_cases.description: Model update changes residual-stream dimensionality or layer semantics invalidating all cached directions and coefficients
edge_cases.mitigation: Trigger full re-extraction and re-calibration on any model architecture change; version-lock steering artifacts to model checkpoint

edge_cases.description: Coefficient calibrated on short prompts generalizes poorly to long-context inputs where effect magnitude degrades
edge_cases.mitigation: Include long-context prompts in calibration suite; report effect-vs-length curve separately

workflow.gate: concept definition approved; permitted/prohibited use cases documented

workflow.action: Design and collect contrastive activation dataset
workflow.gate: >=50 diverse pairs; t-SNE cluster separation confirmed

workflow.action: Extract concept direction and select layer
workflow.gate: layer-sweep peak identified; direction cosine stability >0.90

workflow.action: Evaluate direction via probe accuracy and causal patching
workflow.gate: probe accuracy >70% held-out; causal patching consistent with probe ranking
post-orth probe accuracy within 5% of pre-orth

workflow.action: Deploy steering via ActAdd or control vectors; calibrate coefficient
workflow.gate: Pareto-optimal alpha identified; coherence floor maintained

workflow.action: Measure capability-safety tradeoff and benchmark regression
workflow.gate: regression within +-3% on all benchmarks; Pareto frontier documented

workflow.action: Deploy to production with monitoring and rollback
workflow.gate: latency overhead <2ms; rollback tested; monitoring dashboard live
iteration cycle documented; gate criteria checked at each revision

workflow.action: Apply style/verbosity steering for product use cases
workflow.gate: style metric shift confirmed; content accuracy unchanged

workflow.action: Survey literature nodes for research context
workflow.gate: literature summaries accurate; scope boundary cross-references present

dominance_rules.rule: SCOPE_BOUNDARY dominates all other nodes when content approaches operational safety-disabling steps
dominance_rules.trigger: any node proposes operational refusal-direction ablation steps
dominance_rules.action: reject content; reinstate scope boundary constraint

dominance_rules.rule: CAP_SAFETY_TRADEOFF must gate PRODUCTION_DEPLOY; no deployment without measured tradeoff
dominance_rules.trigger: PRODUCTION_DEPLOY attempted before CAP_SAFETY_TRADEOFF passes acceptance tests
dominance_rules.action: block deployment; require tradeoff measurement first

dominance_rules.rule: PROBE_EVAL and causal validation must precede ACTADD deployment in production
dominance_rules.trigger: ACTADD deployed without PROBE_EVAL gate passed
dominance_rules.action: require probe evaluation and causal patching before production hook

dominance_rules.rule: COEFF_CALIBRATION must precede STYLE_VERBOSITY and any production steering
dominance_rules.trigger: style or production steering applied without coefficient calibration
dominance_rules.action: require Pareto coefficient sweep before style deployment

dominance_rules.trigger: multi-concept superposition attempted with raw non-orthogonalized directions
dominance_rules.action: require orthogonalization and interference validation first

dominance_rules.rule: HUMAN_EVAL required before production deployment for style-facing features
dominance_rules.trigger: STYLE_VERBOSITY deployed to users without HUMAN_EVAL gate
dominance_rules.action: require human preference study before release

dominance_rules.rule: Model architecture change triggers full re-extraction of all directions and re-calibration
dominance_rules.action: invalidate all cached directions and coefficients; restart from CONTRAST_DATA

dominance_rules.rule: NONLINEAR_LIMITS characterization must inform coefficient safety cap before large-scale deployment
dominance_rules.trigger: coefficient set above empirically observed breakdown point
dominance_rules.action: enforce coefficient cap from NONLINEAR_LIMITS analysis

dominance_rules.rule: BENCHMARK_REGRESS flagging >5% regression on safety-relevant benchmark triggers human review before deployment
dominance_rules.action: escalate to human review; block deployment gate

dominance_rules.rule: LAYER_SELECTION must be validated by causal patching for high-risk steering applications
dominance_rules.trigger: high-risk node (risk_if_wrong>=0.80) uses steering without causal layer validation
dominance_rules.action: require activation patching confirmation of layer choice

anti_rework_rules.rule: Do not re-extract directions when only the coefficient is being tuned
anti_rework_rules.rationale: Direction extraction is independent of coefficient; coefficient sweep operates on fixed direction

anti_rework_rules.rule: Do not re-run full human evaluation when only automated metric thresholds changed
anti_rework_rules.rationale: Human evaluation validates behavioral alignment; threshold changes require only re-checking existing data

anti_rework_rules.rule: Do not re-design contrastive pairs when only layer selection is revised
anti_rework_rules.rationale: Contrastive pairs are upstream of layer selection; layer changes do not require new pairs unless concept definition changed

anti_rework_rules.rule: Do not re-orthogonalize when a new unrelated concept is added to the library
anti_rework_rules.rationale: Orthogonalization only runs between pairs of concepts that may co-activate; uncorrelated new concept does not trigger re-orth

anti_rework_rules.rule: Do not re-run benchmark regression when only the reading head threshold is adjusted
anti_rework_rules.rationale: Reading head thresholds are monitoring config; benchmark regression tests steered model capability not monitoring sensitivity

anti_rework_rules.rule: Do not re-run causal patching when probe accuracy is re-measured on new prompt templates
anti_rework_rules.rationale: Causal patching validates mechanism; probe re-measurement validates representation coverage - separate concerns

anti_rework_rules.rule: Do not re-run full iteration loop when only monitoring thresholds are adjusted in production
anti_rework_rules.rationale: Monitoring threshold changes are config changes; full iteration loop required only when direction or coefficient changes

anti_rework_rules.rule: Do not re-collect contrastive pairs when re-running orthogonalization between existing concepts
anti_rework_rules.rationale: Orthogonalization operates on existing direction vectors; pair collection only needed when concept definition changes

anti_rework_rules.rule: Do not re-validate transfer generalization when style direction is applied to an already-evaluated domain
anti_rework_rules.rationale: Transfer validation is per new domain; re-evaluation required only for previously unevaluated domains

anti_rework_rules.rule: Do not re-run literature survey nodes when empirical steering experiments are repeated
anti_rework_rules.rationale: Literature survey nodes document published findings and are only revised when new papers change the field

iteration_protocol.trigger: probe accuracy on held-out pairs below 70%
iteration_protocol.action: Revise contrastive pair design: increase pair count, improve template diversity, check for confounds

iteration_protocol.trigger: causal patching result contradicts probe accuracy ranking
iteration_protocol.action: Investigate discrepancy; consider alternative layer or direction; update MECHANISTIC_INTERP findings

iteration_protocol.trigger: coherence degradation observed above chosen coefficient
iteration_protocol.action: Re-run coefficient calibration with tighter quality floor; update NONLINEAR_LIMITS characterization

iteration_protocol.trigger: human evaluation preference below 55% for steered output on target dimension
iteration_protocol.action: Revisit contrastive pair design and coefficient; consider concept redefinition

iteration_protocol.trigger: benchmark regression exceeds 3% threshold at deployment coefficient
iteration_protocol.action: Reduce coefficient or investigate regression source; repeat CAP_SAFETY_TRADEOFF measurement

iteration_protocol.trigger: model architecture update (new checkpoint or version)
iteration_protocol.action: Invalidate all cached directions and coefficients; restart from CONTRAST_DATA with same pairs on new model

iteration_protocol.trigger: transfer generalization drops below 60% on new deployment domain
iteration_protocol.action: Collect domain-specific contrastive pairs; re-extract direction or fine-tune with domain data
Re-run orthogonalization; reduce number of superposed concepts; update MULTI_CONCEPT envelope

iteration_protocol.trigger: production reading head score diverges from human concept ratings
iteration_protocol.action: Recalibrate reading head threshold; investigate whether concept has drifted or prompt distribution shifted

iteration_protocol.trigger: regulatory or ToS guidance changes scope of permitted steering applications
iteration_protocol.action: Review SCOPE_BOUNDARY node; update permitted/prohibited use lists; conduct human review of all high-risk nodes

priority_rationale: SCOPE_BOUNDARY first because it constrains all subsequent nodes. REPENG_FOUNDATIONS second as theoretical anchor. Data and direction extraction nodes precede application nodes. Evaluation gates precede deployment. Literature survey nodes last as reference only.

structural_checks: all CQ refs resolve to CQ_XX ids
priority_order contains every node id exactly once
obligation_checks: high risk_if_wrong nodes have non-empty acceptance_tests and human_review_required=true
high cross_topic_coupling nodes have non-empty revisit_triggers
conflict edges have signed_tension<0 and resolution_rule
